suppression_sources.upload: an opt-out column in a file (evidence: source, receiptId)
suppression_sources.crm|api_push|form|whatsapp: optOut in a webhook event (evidence: source)
suppression_sources.dpdp: added by erasure when none existed (evidence: requestedBy)

dial_time_attributes.rule: Every attribute row has one current value per (contact_id, key) with authority, observed_at, max_age_s and source_id. A value is usable for dial-time facts only while observed_at + max_age_s > now (max_age_s null = no expiry). Stale values must not be spoken (campaigns reason ATTRIBUTE_STALE); contact.get returns stale per key.
dial_time_attributes.self_subjects: name, first_name, last_name, language, timezone, preferred_time, preferred_channel, address_as, pace: person 100 > agent 60 > crm 50 = upload 50 > system 30. name, language and timezone are mirrored onto contact columns; read those.
dial_time_attributes.record_subjects: every other key (amount_due, due_date, plan, status, record keys, external_id ...): system 100 > crm 80 > agent 75 > upload 70 > person 40. Amounts and dates may be spoken only from these rows, never from speech.
dial_time_attributes.never_attributes: Aadhaar, PAN, bank, card, OTP and password columns are dropped at mapping and never stored. Consent, opt-out and DND are ledgers (consent_record, suppression, dnd_status), not attributes; use contact.dial_facts.
dial_time_attributes.freshness_defaults: upload 30 days, crm and system 24 h, agent and person no expiry; a source can set its own max age.
dial_time_attributes.age_keys: date_of_birth (ISO date), age, is_minor are canonical; see AGE_KEY_SYNONYMS / canonicalAgeKey exported from intake/index.ts

notes: Display ORDER BYs use the database collation on purpose (names read in the locale); the one comparison that decides membership (audience filter gt/lt on text) uses COLLATE "C".
